ModMetaData.name: IsoRim Waylith - VFE Factory Pack
ModMetaData.author: Lin
ModMetaData.description:
Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory in IsoRim's 3D view and on IsoRimZ floors.
- 3D models for all factories, conveyor belts, factory hoppers, the autofarmer, boosters and heatsinks - Items on the belts follow your IsoRim item settings - With IsoRimZ: tall machines need an open double-height room; drill platforms stay on the ground; autofarmers work on their own floor
Needs the latest IsoRim Waylith; older versions load without the models.
让 Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory 在 IsoRim 的 3D 视角和 IsoRimZ 的楼层上正常工作。
- 所有工厂、传送带、工厂料斗、自动农场、增压器和散热器的 3D 模型 - 传送带上的物品跟随 IsoRim 的物品显示设置 - 配合 IsoRimZ：高大的机器需要挑高空间；自动钻井平台只能建在地面；自动农场只在自己的楼层工作
需要最新版 IsoRim Waylith；版本较旧时也能加载，只是没有模型。
